archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark variant for Sales Authority)

headings.usage: H1 text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. Never center by default, left-aligned for data/action focus.

body.usage: text-base for main body, text-lg for lead paragraphs.

labels_and_metrics.tracking: tracking-[0.2em] for labels, tracking-tighter for huge numbers
labels_and_metrics.usage: Overlines, stat blocks, data points. MUST be uppercase for labels.

rules: Use 'Grid Borders' style for data-heavy sections.
No purple or teal for CTAs.
Primary accent is Emerald (Money/Growth) to signify increased sales/revenue.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with intense contrast.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID for dashboards/calculators, MODE A for case studies.
rules: Use generous padding p-8 inside cards with borders.
Optical alignment: left-align dense content and buttons.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): border-r border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_borders.header: Glassmorphism (Crystal): backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0F17]/80 border-b border-white/10. Sticky z-50.
surfaces_and_borders.buttons: Sharp edges, solid emerald bg, sharp 1px border. Focus state ring-2 ring-emerald-300.

motion_and_interactions.hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, text color explicitly set (e.g. hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered reveals for lists, ticker tape of stats, scroll-triggered counters.

components.strategy: Hybrid: Custom HTML/Tailwind for layouts, heavily customized Shadcn for forms/interactive elements.

specifics.Hero: Outcome-focused headline + dual CTA. Use Grid layout. 'Stop Discounting. Start Creating Excitement.'
specifics.Testimonials: Mix of consumer (vacation photos) and business (sales stats). Place strategically.
specifics.ROI_Calculator: Sliders for # reps, avg deal size, close rate -> projected uplift. 'Control Room' grid style.
specifics.Stats_Bar: React-fast-marquee or Grid for '37% avg. close-rate lift', 'Used by 1,200+ teams'.
specifics.Sticky_CTA: Fixed bottom bar for lead-gen. 'Increase Sales Without Sacrificing Margin'.
specifics.Forms: Multi-field Lead capture form using Shadcn Input/Select.

rules: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 for hero images. Use gradient overlays if needed for text contrast.
Blend business imagery with travel aspiration.

image_urls.description: Diverse group of professionals in a modern office meeting.
Two people shaking hands in an office, symbolizing agreement.
Placeholder for logo/trust badges if needed

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Sales-Enablement Authority site, NOT a travel booking site.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-demo', data-testid='roi-calc-slider').
Follow the Archetype 4 Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark) color palette.
Implement the ROI calculator using Shadcn Slider components.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for complex marketing layouts, Shadcn only for form/interactive logic.
Incorporate the Dropbox images into the 'Programs' and 'Consumer Testimonials' sections.
Use the business Pexels images for the hero or 'Business Testimonials' / 'How it works' sections.
Provide empty container placeholders for the 'How to use in a closing' video series.
Create pages/sections for: Home, About, Services/Programs, Industries Served, Case Studies, Contact, Blog/Resources, Form.
